issues.title: Template changes
issues.body:
**Hold on this until stakeholders have reviewed templates document**

Templates in the Air domain include a checkbox for `A to A`. This caused some confusion, and should be replaced with `Air to Air`

Note: I have email from Giles with lists of values to use.

While I'm in the templates, I should also make these changes:
- drop-down lists in domain templates for:
    - [x] Posture 
    - [x] Emcon state
    - [x] Rules of Engagement
    - [x] Supports High Level?
    - [x] Activity Card ?   (should
- [x] Remove `Search rate` from ISTAR template
- [x] Remove `transit speed` and `duration` from `Transit` template
- [x] Move `Activity Description` higher in the template.
- [x] Remove `target type` from Strike
- [x] Remove `Observation method` from `ISTAR`
- [x] Remove `Search Rate` from `ISTAR`
- [x] Remove `Outcomes from a set of orders` from Adjudication Template
